digest.component_or_area: CLI author guides and commit-trailer documentation
propositions: CLI-served packaged guides contain dangling consumer-relative cross-references (e.g. review-policy.md, ../CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/commit-ticket-trailer.md) that fail to resolve for repo-less clients
The commit-trailer format (EXPECTED_FORMAT in verify_commit.py) has no CLI-discoverable home; it is only documented in rebar verify-commit-ticket --help with no pointer from main documentation
Packaged guides must repoint all internal links to either sibling guides via rebar explain <topic> or repo-only docs via https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/blob/main URLs
A guard test must prevent future regression by asserting no packaged _guides/*.md contains consumer-relative path links
The MCP explain_criterion tool docstring hardcodes the guide list and does not include the new commit-trailer topic
commit-trailer must be registered in AUTHOR_GUIDES and discoverable via rebar explain commit-trailer alongside plan and review guides
